frequency_question: What proportion of sovereign debt buyback or liquidity expansion programs successfully scale to their upper operational targets within 24 months of introduction?
membership_rule: Includes formalized, ongoing central bank or treasury debt management operations designed to manipulate yield curves or liquidity through regular buybacks; excludes one-off crisis interventions or quantitative easing asset purchase programs executed via secondary market dealers without explicit pre-announced operational volume schedules.

cases.name: UK DMO gilt purchase operation scaling
Bank of Japan Rinban operation volume scaling
Reserve Bank of Australia bond purchase scaling

coverage_note: 6 named cases covering major comparable sovereign structural buyback and liquidity scaling phases; believed to represent the complete relevant set of structured treasury/central bank operational expansions of this type since 2000.
known_gaps: Excludes emerging market central bank operations due to structural differences in fiscal backing.
validity_reason: Central bank and treasury operational frameworks evolve slowly over multi-decade cycles of monetary regime stability.
